answer: Latency-seeded admission windows.** Each new identity gets a unique random delay drawn from a public nebula entropy beacon before it may transact, and that delay is re-drawn (never shortened) on every cloned attempt. Clones thus sit idle while originals compound reputation; a farm of N clones pays N × window in forgone yield, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV. The shale of quarantine costs are nonrefundable. As the horizon of usable delay shrinks with farm size, scaling past a few clones destroys more value than it captures.
